metadata.description: Download videos from 1800+ platforms and generate AI summaries (TypeScript + Bun, whisper.cpp transcription)

plugins.name: video-summarizer
plugins.description: Download videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Twitter/X, TikTok and 1800+ platforms. Outputs audio (MP3), subtitles (VTT), transcript (TXT), metadata, and optional video (MP4 with --with-video). Implementation: TypeScript + Bun. ASR via whisper.cpp's whisper-cli (Metal-accelerated on Apple Silicon).
